name: Machu Picchu (Urubamba gorge, Cusco region, Peru)
note: Terrain benchmark site (user request 2026-11-24). Not a declared held-out metro (M15 reserved Lima and Trujillo for Peru).
centre_note: the citadel shifted 75 m east and 150 m north, so that the 2048 m domain holds the citadel saddle, Huayna Picchu, the Hiram Bingham switchbacks and the Urubamba on the west and north-east

city_limits.note: geometry only (an ellipse along the Machu Picchu ridge with a noisy edge, water removed); NOT selected on slope, so that where each generator builds is part of the test
